warden.name: Old Warden
warden.1: So you came after all. The keep has burned for nine nights.
warden.2: Cinderlings swarm the courtyard. Strike them down before they touch you: [color=$accent]J[/color], [color=$accent]F[/color] or [color=$accent]X[/color] on a pad.
warden.3: Your swing also scatters the embers the spitters throw.
warden.4: Clear the courtyard and the gate will open. The throne waits beyond. Go.
